Cabbage Salad For A Crowd
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 heads of cabbage (depending on size cabbage
size of salad)
Green onions
Slivered almonds
Sesame seeds

Preparation

1 Prepare ahead of time and refrigerate: 4 tbsp. sugar 4 tbsp. garlic wine vinegar Pepper (opt.) 2 pkgs. chicken flavoring from Top Ramen noodle soup (save noodles) 2 Chop cabbage and onion, crush noodles into salad and pour on dressing and toss.
